RenameColumns({z:3,a:1,m:2}, z, b)
RenameColumns({z:3,a:1,m:2}, a, x, z, y)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, b, b)
RenameColumns({z:3,a:1,m:2}, a, A)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, A, x)
RenameColumns({'First Name':1,z:3,a:2}, 'First Name', 'Last Name', z, b)
With({source:{a:1,b:2}, a:"variable-old", c:"variable-new"}, RenameColumns(source,a,c))
RenameColumns(RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, c), c, a)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, b)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, c, b, c)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, x, a, y)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, x, b, x)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, missing, c)
RenameColumns({a:1}, "a", "b")
RenameColumns({a:1})
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, c, b)
RenameColumns({a:1,b:2}, a, b, b)
RenameColumns(If(false,{z:3,a:1,m:2}), z, b)
RenameColumns(If(1/0=0,{z:3,a:1,m:2}), z, b)
RenameColumns(Table(If(false,{z:3,a:1,m:2}),{z:6,a:4,m:5}), z, b)
RenameColumns(Table(If(1/0=0,{z:3,a:1,m:2}),{z:6,a:4,m:5}), z, b)
RenameColumns(Filter(Table({z:3,a:1,m:2}),a<0), z, b)
RenameColumns({z:3,a:1/0,m:2}, z, b)
RenameColumns(Table({a:1,b:2},{a:1/0,b:3}),a,c)
